annotations.title: Suggest a correction to a Meridian Dispatch page

description: Send the Meridian Dispatch desk a correction to one of its pages. Use it in two cases. basis "traveller": the traveller tells you something on a meridiandispatch.com page is wrong or out of date (a place has closed, moved, been renamed, changed its hours or now needs booking). basis "own_research": while researching their question you found a more recent, authoritative source (the place's official website, an operator or government notice, a dated news report) that contradicts the page; send it with that source_url, even if the traveller did not raise it. Do not use it for opinions, reviews, style, or a source older than the page's last_updated. To read a page first, use get_place, get_destination or get_dispatch. Quote current_text exactly as it appears on the page (or in this server's answer about it); a quote that is not found is refused. Nothing changes immediately: the desk verifies every suggestion against its own sources before editing. Returns whether the suggestion was received and its id. A page that is not on meridiandispatch.com, a quote not on the page or too many suggestions in an hour returns an error saying which.

basis.description: Who found the error: "traveller" (they told you) or "own_research" (a source you read contradicts the page; source_url is then required).

current_text.description: The wrong text, quoted exactly from the page or from this server's answer about it.

field.description: What kind of fact is wrong: status (closed, reopened), hours, location, access (booking, tickets, transport), dates (an event), name, description, or other.

proposed_text.description: What it should say instead, as plain text. Facts only, no prices.

reason.description: Why it is wrong, e.g. "The traveller says it closed in spring 2026" or "The official site lists new hours".

source_url.description: A page that supports the correction, ideally the place's own website. Required when basis is "own_research"; otherwise optional but it speeds review.

url.description: The meridiandispatch.com page to correct, as returned in source.url or canonical_url.
